notes.title: Great improvements coming to next update !
notes.notes:
We have been doing some work on the game as we wanted to bring some improvements !

* the new engine, and improvements to clutch and tire physics should bring a new and exciting slides
* the car list has changed. We have added some more exciting cars
* we are also working on a couple more free drift areas

* Online Multiplayer mode will most likely come in v1.8.0 in case we wont manage to implement it in v1.7.0

notes.title: Adding Free Roam mode in next update !
notes.notes:
In next update Free Roam mode should be added !

Some notes:

* This will be a mode where you drift in some area and complete stunts and play free roam events. When you complete the requirements, the free roam area will be considered completed and players will be rewarded.

* In this upcoming update, buying and upgrading vehicles may get back into the game in order for the free roam mode plus earning XP point and credits to make some sense !

* The free roam is designed in a way where there might be added more areas with game updates instead of creating one big open world area ! Areas will however be not that small !

Cheers !

notes.title: Update v1.5.0
notes.notes:
JDI v1.5.0 is here with a few fixes and optimizations

IMPROVED :
* Cars are a bit more responsive and easier to control
* Exhaust audio and visuals are improved
* New tire texture
* Challenges target scores are lowered

FIXED :
* Tire side slip values are a bit mode accurate now
* Brake lights were not working due to shader change
* Normal maps on tire rims were not visible
* Some leaderboards were not updated
* Current player position in leaderboard was not loaded on challenge complete
* Minimap on Main Track level was not visible
* Music and Ambient audio sliders couldn't be changed using mouse

* Some more internal fixes and improvements

notes.title: JDI update 2 is now live !
notes.notes:
The second update of JDI  is now live !

New

* Painting car parts - car body, rims, rims spokes and calipers
* New nicer default color combinations for all cars
* New and better in game cameras plus camera manager - use key "B" to toggle menu in game
* Audio player key bind is added. Use now key "M" on keyboard to open player in game
* New level based on completing laps, based on Challenge 5 is added
* Added rear wings to second and third vehicle

Improved

* Auto counter steer helper is improved and now recommended to enable, for nicer drifts
* First car upgrades required level is lowered, to let players upgrade it quickly
* Screen space reflection option in game settings in now enabled. Use to toggle on/off SSR

notes.title: First update of JDI is now available !
notes.notes:
Hi to all. The first update of JDI is here. This is what's new and improved:

New:

[list]
[*] In game audio player to play local mp3 and wav files located on HDD ( check in game info )
[*] Car upgrades
[*] Two more cars added
[*] New challenge ( more to come later )
[*] Turbo sound and exhaust effects
[*] Choose KM/h or MP/h from the settings
[/list]

Improved/Fixed:

[list]
[*] Automatic gearing is now set as default
[*] Car slide at zero speed in forward direction is fully eliminated ( still side slides a little )
[*] UI improvements
[*] Leaderboard window can show top 20, entries around player and friends list
[*] Tune sliders have been improved and some tune info has been added
[*] Player level has been increased to 30
[*] Spawning sparkles from scratching
[*] New Speedometer design
[*] New loading screen
[*] Fixed audio glitches in menus
[/list]
